interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with model-led routing, evidence-gated research, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools. Explicit consultations and material continuation changes receive a full validated consultation dashboard through a local read-only MCP tool and accessible MCP App UI, with a Markdown fallback. The view model is derived from the existing C3/C27/research validators and never uses unknown denominators. The local tool cannot detect omitted work or authenticate model-reported activity, and no host release hook is established. Includes the externally maintained EU and national source library mirrored into the plugin package. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness. Personal use is intended. Non-personal use for an employer, business, organization, client, customer or other third party, paid services, or deploying the plugin for others requires a license; request one at eudirective@proton.me.
